races.paceDynamic: Traprain Law, Classic Maestro, Sans Bruit and Palacio will ensure a strong gallop from the outset with four confirmed front-runners in a nine-horse field. The soft ground will test stamina reserves as this quartet battles for early positioning, with prominent runners Matata, Calico and Le Nez Creux creating congestion behind. The pace will be honest throughout, potentially turning into a war of attrition over the final half-mile. This setup strongly favours horses with proven stamina and the tactical speed to pick up the pieces, benefiting prominent/midfield runners who can capitalise on the pace battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace battle between Traprain Law, Classic Maestro, Sans Bruit and Palacio proves too fierce in the testing conditions.
scenarios.body: The quartet will weaken from 3 out, allowing prominent trackers to strike with superior finishing kicks. Horses like Calico and Matata, sitting just off the pace, will have the perfect setup to pounce.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Traprain Law Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Traprain Law can assert early and stretch the field with his superior class and recent course form.
scenarios.body: His 77-day break will prove beneficial rather than detrimental, and he'll grind out the finish in testing conditions that suit his style perfectly. The other front-runners will crack trying to match his relentless gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Calico's Class Shows
scenarios.trigger: If Harry Skelton can position Calico perfectly behind the pace battle and time his run to perfection.
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old's recent wins over similar trips and his proven soft ground form will tell, benefiting from the strong pace setup. His superior class rating will prove decisive in a finish where stamina is at a premium.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise From Back Division
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and a hold-up horse finds the gaps at the right time.
scenarios.body: The soft ground will slow the pace more than expected, allowing a patient ride to pay dividends. However, with only prominent/leading types in this field, this scenario requires significant pace collapse.

watchPoints.text: Multiple front-runners Traprain Law, Classic Maestro, Sans Bruit and Palacio could set unsustainable pace in soft conditions, causing late collapse.
Traffic problems likely at 2-3 out with seven of nine runners wanting prominent positions creating potential interference.
Amateur rider Lucas Murphy on Aeros Luck may struggle with tactical positioning in such a pace-heavy contest.
Calico's jumping under pressure after 38-day break will determine if class can overcome tactical disadvantage.
Classic Maestro's response to pressure with inexperienced Luke Scott will show if recent improved form is sustainable.

races.paceDynamic: Milcree, Diamond Dealer, Caughtinyourtrance and Big John Wayne will set a strong gallop from the start with four confirmed front-runners in a 15-runner field. The pace will be genuine throughout this 3m test on soft ground, with Diamond Dealer and Milcree likely to take it up early before the others join the battle. This sustained gallop will stretch the field and test stamina reserves over the final half-mile. The strong pace scenario clearly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with proven stamina who can finish strongly when the early leaders tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the four front-runners maintain a fierce gallop through the first two miles
scenarios.body: The pace will be unsustainable and the early leaders will fold dramatically in the final half-mile, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep through. Horses like I Wish You, Young Jack and Gamesters Guy who race off the pace will benefit from the collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Compromise Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Diamond Dealer or Milcree manages the tempo more cleverly than expected
scenarios.body: One of the front-runners will dictate terms and still have enough left to repel late challengers, with prominent racers getting first run on the weakening leader. This favours the classier front-runners and those who can track the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Positioning Key
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but not destructive, creating a tactical middle section
scenarios.body: The race will become about positioning turning for home rather than pure stamina, favouring horses who can travel well in midfield. Prominent racers with tactical speed will benefit most from this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble Finish
scenarios.trigger: If jumping errors or interference disrupts the rhythm of several key contenders
scenarios.body: The race will become fragmented with the winner coming from an unexpected position, potentially favouring a horse who avoids trouble. This chaos scenario could throw up a surprise from the outsiders.

watchPoints.text: Milcree and Diamond Dealer could set suicidal fractions early if both refuse to yield the lead
Califet En Vol running again after just one day could show signs of fatigue in the closing stages
I Wish You's ability to get a clear run from the back given the large field and likely strong pace
Pounding Poet returning after 110 days absence may need this run despite his proven ability
The effectiveness of first-time tongue-ties on both Kdeux Saint Fray and Ayiko in this grade

races.paceDynamic: Secret Squirrel and Tellherthename will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a solid gallop on the testing soft ground. Six horses wanting prominent positions (Tutti Quanti, Captain Hugo, Ooh Betty, Dedicated Hero, Welsh Charger plus the two leaders) creates dangerous congestion through the middle stages. The soft going will emphasize stamina over speed, making it a test of staying power rather than a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early traffic and deliver late challenges when the prominent brigade comes under pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too strong and the prominent runners hit the wall.
scenarios.body: The dual pace angle from Secret Squirrel and Tellherthename will set up a perfect storm for closers, with soft ground sapping the speed of those racing keenly early. Gibbs Island, All In You and Queenie St Clair can time their challenges to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one prominent runner can find the perfect position just behind the pace.
scenarios.body: Tutti Quanti or Captain Hugo could sit third or fourth, avoiding the early speed duel while staying close enough to strike when the leaders weaken. The class edge of these two gives them the tactical speed to win from this position.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground slows the pace enough for a leader to last home.
scenarios.body: Secret Squirrel's recent Kempton win shows he can sustain his effort, and if he can dictate terms without Tellherthename pressing him too hard early, he has the class to hold on. The testing conditions will make it hard for others to reel him in.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast and the prominent runners also compromise each other.
scenarios.body: The six horses wanting to race handy could create a messy, stop-start rhythm that plays into the hands of a horse coming from last. This would suit a patient ride on one of the hold-up horses who gets the clearest run.

watchPoints.text: Secret Squirrel and Tellherthename will create a pace duel that could set this up perfectly for closers to exploit.
Traffic congestion developing 2-3 hurdles out with six horses wanting prominent positions in a small field.
Tutti Quanti carrying 20 pounds more than several rivals despite his class advantage from the Nicholls stable.
Welsh Charger returning from 65-day break with trainer Alastair Ralph showing poor 0/10 recent form.
Hold-up horses Gibbs Island and All In You both wearing hoods suggesting connections expect improved efforts.

races.paceDynamic: Pinot Rouge and Princess Keri will contest the early lead, with Princess Keri's superior recent form likely giving her the initiative. However, 6 of 10 runners want prominent positions (World Of Fortunes, Love Of Neymore, Game Colours, Holly Hartingo, Fox's Fancy, Azahara Palace), creating significant congestion and forcing some back. This will produce a genuinely run pace over the extended trip on testing ground, with the race likely developing into a staying test from 2 out. The combination of honest early pace and soft ground strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish, particularly Starlyte and Twistthenightaway.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners create early traffic problems and the pace stays honest throughout
scenarios.body: The soft ground and extended distance will find out the early pace-setters, allowing the patient riders to thread through late. Starlyte and Twistthenightaway have the tactical speed to capitalise when others tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Leader Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If Princess Keri can dictate fractions and avoid serious early pressure from the prominent brigade
scenarios.body: Her recent wins suggest stamina reserves, and if she can control the tempo she may have enough left. The soft ground suits her proven form pattern.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Fight Out
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and the prominent horses settle without interference
scenarios.body: This allows the likes of World Of Fortunes and Game Colours to utilise their class advantage in a tactical finish. Their higher ratings tell late if not emptied early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and the prominent horses also empty from the traffic
scenarios.body: This would set up an unlikely scenario where a closer like Fox's Fancy could benefit from chaos ahead. Requires multiple horses to underperform simultaneously.

races.paceDynamic: Quebecois stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable gallop from the start without pace pressure. The prominent runners like Isaac Des Obeaux, Maximilian, and Katate Dori will track the leader in the early stages, while hold-up horses including Montregard, King Of Answers, and Chasingouttheblues will settle towards the rear. Over 4 miles on soft ground, this uncontested lead scenario creates an honest staying test that will heavily favour the prominent trackers and those with tactical speed to position early, as they can sit close to the steady pace and have first run when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Quebecois maintains his jumping rhythm and isn't pressed for pace through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls runner gets an armchair ride in front and has enough left to resist late challengers up the hill. His solid soft ground record and Harry Cobden's tactical nous prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early prominent horses can sit close to Quebecois and maintain jumping fluency
scenarios.body: The trackers get first run from their ideal positions while the hold-up horses face too much traffic and ground to make up. The race becomes a battle between those who positioned early and avoided trouble.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching in the final mile and the leaders tire dramatically
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up runners get a perfect tow into the race and unleash late runs up the demanding Ayr hill. Montregard's class and King Of Answers' finishing kick prove telling.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders encounter jumping errors or get hampered at crucial stages
scenarios.body: A well-positioned outsider with fresh form capitalizes on the misfortune of favorites to land a surprise victory. The marathon distance levels the playing field.

watchPoints.text: Quebecois jumping fluency in the early stages as any mistake will compromise his front-running tactics completely

Road To Home's jumping under amateur Patrick Mullins as any errors will end his chances quickly
Weather conditions before the off as any further rain will significantly favor the proven soft ground performers

races.paceDynamic: Timesareachanging and Stride On will clash for the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to establish a solid gallop from the start. Behind them, four horses (Laguna Beach, Allfor, Our Boy Stan, and Leader Crik if he runs) want prominent positions, creating congestion and potential traffic issues approaching the final hurdles. The hold-up horses Apache Tribe, Queens Secret, and West Hill Verde will track from the rear, relying on late surges. This setup strongly favours closers and patient hold-up horses who can avoid the early pace battle and profit from what should be a strong gallop on testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Timesareachanging and Stride On go hard early while prominent runners get into trouble.
scenarios.body: The honest pace stretches the field and creates gaps for hold-up horses to exploit in the straight. Apache Tribe and West Hill Verde can unleash their superior class late when others weaken.

scenarios.body: Without pressure, Timesareachanging or Stride On can dictate fractions and kick clear when it matters. The prominent runners benefit from the easier pace and can challenge late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Wide
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet gets bunched up and blocked 3 out on the inner.
scenarios.body: Leaders escape while hold-up horses with room wide can mount late challenges. Those caught in traffic struggle to get competitive positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Then Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders are covered early and nobody wants to make the running.

scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can dictate fractions and kick clear
scenarios.body: Skerry Hill or Coconut Man could exploit their tactical advantage by controlling the tempo and having enough left to repel late challengers. Their front-running style suits the testing conditions perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is unsustainably fast and multiple leaders crack
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of Old Habits and Finisk Pride will pay dividends as they pick up the pieces in the final stages. Their proven ability to finish strongly after sitting off the pace becomes decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unknown Quantity Shocks
scenarios.trigger: If Close House or Busted Springs possesses hidden ability on this surface
scenarios.body: The lightly raced pair could exploit their unexposed status with improvement to hand. Their unknown qualities make them dangerous wildcards in a race where established form might not hold up.

watchPoints.text: Skerry Hill could steal this if allowed to dictate his own fractions from the front without early pressure
Brady Hartsfield carries a 4lb penalty but his recent form suggests he can overcome the weight burden
Close House and Busted Springs are complete unknowns making their debuts and could spring surprises
The pace clash between four confirmed front runners will create a searching gallop that could suit patient types
Keops Des Bordes returns after 473 days off but has Harry Skelton aboard and proven soft ground ability
